III. ESG MANAGEMENT SYSTEM                                                        三、ESG管理體系
  As a globally leading trend culture and entertainment group, Pop Mart               作為全球領先的潮流文化娛樂集團，泡泡
  takes IP as its core and has built a full-link creative incubation and              瑪特以IP為核心，為全球創作者打造了全鏈
  operation platform for creators around the world. It provides consumers             路創意孵化與運營平台，給消費者提供令
  with exciting products and services as well as wonderful entertainment              人心動的產品、服務及美好的娛樂體驗。
  experiences.


  We attach great importance to ESG-related matters in business                       我們高度重視業務經營與風險管理中的ESG

V. EMPLOYMENT AND LABOR STANDARDS                                              五、僱傭及勞工準則
  The Company regards talent as the core resource for the sustainable              本公司將人才視為企業可持續發展的核心
  development of the enterprise. We continuously optimize the talent               資源，不斷優化人才管理體系，制定多元
  management system, formulate diversified talent development                      化人才發展策略，拓寬人才引進渠道，提
  strategies, broaden the channels for talent recruitment, provide                 供多樣化的激勵機制及福利關懷，致力於
  diverse incentive mechanisms and welfare care, and are committed                 為員工創造健康、安全的工作環境，全面
  to creating a healthy and safe working environment for employees.                保障員工合法權益，實現與員工的共同成
  We comprehensively protect the legitimate rights and interests of                長。
  employees and strive to achieve common growth with them.


  Employment Management                                                            僱傭管理
  The Company strictly complies with relevant laws, regulations and                本公司嚴格遵守《中華人民共和國勞動法》

3.2 Capital management                                                          3.2 資本管理
   The Group’s objectives when managing capital are to safeguard the              本集團管理資本之目的為維持其持續經營
   Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide             的能力，以便為本集團擁有人提供回報，
   returns for owners of the Group and to maintain an optimal capital             並維持最佳的資本架構以提高擁有人的長
   structure to enhance owners’ value in the long term.                           期價值。


   The Group monitors capital on the basis of the gearing ratio. This ratio       本集團按照資本負債率監控資本。該比率
   is calculated as net debt divided by total capital. Net debt is calculated     按債務淨額除以總資本計算。債務淨額按
   as total borrowings less cash and cash equivalents. Total capital is           借款總額減去現金及現金等價物計算。總
   calculated as ‘equity’ as shown in the balance sheet plus net debt. As at      資 本 按 資 產 負 債 表 所 示「 權 益 」加 債 務 淨
   31 December 2024, the Group has no net debt. See Note 34(c) for the            額計算。於2024 年12 月31 日，本集團並無
   reconciliation of net cash for the year ended 31 December 2024 and             債務淨額。有關截至2024 年及2023 年12 月
   2023.                                                                          31 日止年度現金淨額的對賬，請參閱附註

      28 SHARE-BASED COMPENSATION                                                    28 以股份為基礎的報酬
         The Company adopted the Share Award Scheme on 24 July 2020                    本公司於 2020 年 7 月 24 日採納股份獎勵計
         with a duration of 10 years commencing from the adoption date. The            劃，自採納日期起為期 10 年。股份獎勵計
         objective of the Share Award Scheme is to align the interests of selected     劃之目的乃使選定參與者的利益與本集團
         participants with those of the Group and to encourage and retain              利益保持一致，鼓勵及挽留選定參與者為

39 SUMMARY OF OTHER ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                           39 其他會計政策概要
   This note provides a list of other potentially material accounting policies      本附註載列編製該等綜合財務報表時所採
   adopted in the preparation of these consolidated financial statements.           用的其他可能重要的會計政策。除非另有
   These policies have been consistently applied to all the years presented,        說明，該等政策始終適用於呈列的全部年
   unless otherwise stated.                                                         份。


(a) Property, plant and equipment                                                 (a) 物業、廠房及設備
   Property, plant and equipment, other than construction in progress, are          物業、廠房及設備（在建工程除外）乃按歷
   stated at historical cost less accumulated depreciation and impairment.          史成本減累計折舊及減值列賬。歷史成本
   Historical cost includes expenditures that are directly attributable to the      包括收購項目的直接應佔支出。
   acquisition of the items.


   Subsequent costs are included in the asset’s carrying amount or                  後續成本僅在項目的相關未來經濟利益很
   recognised as a separate asset, as appropriate, only when it is probable         可能流入本集團，且項目的成本能可靠計
   that future economic benefits associated with the item will flow to the          量之情況下，方計入有關資產之賬面值或
   Group and the cost of the item can be measured reliably. The carrying            確認為獨立資產（如適用）。替換零件的賬
   amount of the replaced part is derecognised. All other repairs and               面值不予確認。所有其他維修及保養費在
   maintenance are charged in the consolidated statement of profit or loss          其產生的財政期間自綜合損益及其他全面
   and other comprehensive income during the financial period in which              收益表扣除。
   they are incurred.


   Depreciation on property, plant and equipment is calculated using the            物業、廠房及設備以直線法按以下估計可
   straight-line method to allocate their cost, net of their residual values,       使用年期分配成本（扣除剩餘價值）計算折
   over their estimated useful lives, as follows:                                   舊：


   Roboshop machines                                5 years                         機器人商店售貨機 5年
   Moulds                                           1.5-3 years                     模具              1.5至3年
   Equipment and others                             5 years                         設備及其他           5年
   Leasehold improvement                            Shorter of remaining            租賃裝修            餘下租期或可使用
                                                      lease term or useful life                       年期，以較短者為準


   The assets’ residual values and useful lives are reviewed, and adjusted if       資產的剩餘價值及可使用年期於各結算日
   appropriate, at each balance sheet date.                                         均會進行檢討，並在適當情況下作出調整。


   An asset’s carrying amount is written down immediately to its                    倘資產賬面值高於其估計可收回金額，則
   recoverable amount if the asset’s carrying amount is greater than its            會立即將該資產的賬面值撇減至其可收回
   estimated recoverable amount.                                                    金額。

(d) Offsetting financial instruments                                            (d) 抵銷金融工具
   Financial assets and liabilities are offset and the net amount reported in     當有合法可強制執行權利抵銷已確認金
   the balance sheet when there is a legally enforceable right to offset the      額，並有意按淨額基準結算或同時變現資
   recognised amounts and there is an intention to settle on a net basis          產和結算負債時，金融資產與負債可互相
   or realise the asset and settle the liability simultaneously. The legally      抵銷，並在資產負債表呈報其淨額。合法
   enforceable right must not be contingent on future events and must be          可強制執行權利不得依賴未來事件而定，
   enforceable in the normal course of business and in the event of default,      而在一般業務過程中以及倘本集團或對手
   insolvency or bankruptcy of the Group or the counterparty.                     方一旦出現違約、無償債能力或破產時，
                                                                                  其必須為可強制執行。


(e) Cash and cash equivalents                                                   (e) 現金及現金等價物
   In the consolidated statement of cash flows, cash and cash equivalents         於綜合現金流量表中，現金及現金等價物
   includes cash in hand, deposits held at call with banks and other              包括手頭現金、銀行活期存款及其他原到
   short-term highly liquid investments with original maturities of three         期日為三個月或以內的高流動性短期投資。
   months or less.


(f) Share capital and shares held for Share Award Scheme                        (f) 股本及就股份獎勵計劃持有的股份
   Ordinary shares are classified as equity.                                      普通股分類為權益。


   Incremental costs directly attributable to the issuance of new shares are      發行新股份直接應佔增量成本在權益內列
   shown in equity as a deduction, net of tax, from the proceeds.                 為所得款項（除稅後）的扣減。


   Shares held for the Share Award Scheme are disclosed as “Shares held           就股份獎勵計劃持有的股份披露於「就股份
   for Share Award Scheme” and deducted from equity until the shares are          獎勵計劃持有的股份」，且自權益扣除，直
   vested or cancelled.                                                           至股份歸屬或註銷為止。

   These amounts represent liabilities for goods and services provided            該等金額指於財政年度結束前向本集團提
   to the Group prior to the end of financial year which are unpaid. The          供商品及服務的未支付負債。有關金額乃
